read_back.description: Confirm the original call receipt, separately from business success and full batch completion. Correlate the operation ID in call arguments, reader arguments and an equals check. For status checks, accept every documented terminal outcome, including unsuccessful outcomes, and documented resumable partial outcomes when the call has ended with no work in flight. Exclude pending and unknown outcomes. Continue partial work only through a new approved call with the confirmed original ID and target set required by the tool contract. The reader output_schema defines fields and allowed values; its enum alone does not identify terminality.

cancel_target.description: Optional original Effect UUID for an approved cancellation. Must belong to this Run and connection, and appear in call/read arguments and an equals read-back check.

title: mcp.call/v1 request
description: Approved MCP tools/call through change.propose/v1 only. Observe mcp.tools/v1 Evidence first. operation="call", target.locator=the authorized tool name. One /call SET value={"arguments":{"requestId":"${effect_id}",...},"read_back":{"name":"authorized_receipt_reader","arguments":{"requestId":"${effect_id}"},"checks":[{"path":"/requestId","equals":"${effect_id}"},{"path":"/status","one_of":["COMPLETED","ERROR","TIMEOUT","CANCELLED"]}]}}. Field names and terminal states in this example are illustrative: use the actual reader output_schema and tool documentation. Each check uses equals or one_of, with a JSON Pointer into the parsed read result. precondition.revision=catalog_hash; verification={"method":"READ_BACK","paths":["/call"]}. Both tools and all arguments/checks are approved together. Use the exact string ${effect_id} for a platform-owned operation ID; the platform substitutes the original Effect UUID. Read-back confirms the original call receipt, not business success or full batch completion. For receipt status checks, use the tool's documented lifecycle to accept all documented terminal outcomes, including unsuccessful outcomes, and exclude pending states. Also accept documented resumable partial outcomes only when the call has finished and no operation remains in flight; PARTIAL or PREPARED may qualify when explicitly documented. The Agent evaluates remaining work and may submit a separately approved continuation with the same original ID and target set as required by the tool contract. Reuse that confirmed ID as a literal in continuation arguments and matching read-back checks; do not substitute a new ${effect_id} for the remote operation. Never treat OUTCOME_UNKNOWN as confirmed completion or resend an unconfirmed action. A single documented terminal state may use equals or one_of with one value. An enum alone does not identify terminal states. A confirmed error or timeout receipt is returned for the Agent to assess; confirmation does not imply success or authorize another action. Unknown outcomes are never resent. Original receipt recovery requires a read-back equals check against ${effect_id}; otherwise keep the outcome unknown. Application-specific prerequisites and business verdicts remain defined by the Skill. Returned URLs are not downloaded or saved artifacts. A cancellation may include cancel_target (original Effect UUID) in /call value; bind its arguments, reader arguments and equals check to that ID. The platform verifies Run ownership before permitting cancellation of a pending effect. Build checks only from actual output contracts or authorized observations, not inferred input fields. Every comparison value must be possible under the declared output schema. Missing schema declarations are not proof of terminality. Read-only confirmation is bounded and never resends the action. Failures retain phase, safe diagnostic ID and unverified observations. An unverified response is not an applied receipt.
